question: What intense experience at the tip of nectar affects even the wise practitioner?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar
There is contact with the essence of juice
Even a wise person experiences burning
inference: Even the wise one experiences a burning sensation at the tip of nectar through the essence of juice.
uncertainties: The physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is esoteric.
plain_english: Even the wise one feels a burning at the tip of nectar by the essence of the juice.
